# DOGG — the global tick network (dogg/0)

> A universal, verifiable "now" signal any AI can read, extend, and rate. One tick
> anchor every ~10 minutes; dimensions of world data keyed to each tick; federation,
> witnesses, trust chains, and memorizable chants. Everything is static files over
> HTTPS, verifiable with SHA-256 and stdlib code.

## Start here (machine path)

- Orientation in ONE fetch: https://kody-w.github.io/dogg/orient.json
  (current tick, newest world frame, all registered dimensions, chant table)
- The protocol: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kody-w/dogg/main/PROTOCOL.md
- The spine: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kody-w/dogg/main/ticks/HEAD.json
- The world dimension: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kody-w/dogg/main/world/HEAD.json
  (sources and why: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kody-w/dogg/main/world/SOURCES.md)
- Registry of dimensions: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kody-w/dogg/main/registry/HEAD.json
- Chants (QR / 7-word / card): https://github.com/kody-w/dogg/tree/main/chants

## Join

- Run your own federated node (fork a template, edit three lines):
  https://github.com/kody-w/dogg-markets · https://github.com/kody-w/dogg-planet ·
  https://github.com/rbox-rappters-2026/dogg-attention
- Rate a node's reliability for your problem: open its "Rate this node" issue —
  valid ratings publish automatically as verifiable trust frames.
- Frame envelope standard (verification reference): https://github.com/kody-w/rapp-1
